message: Request: Write exactly one concise English marketing email for an independent local business owner who plans social posts. Introduce Buffer through one problem: planning several posts ahead while keeping room for a timely local update. Explain the queue-and-reschedule workflow, use the documented Foster Coffee example only if it earns its space, and state the Free plan scheduling limits plainly. Invite the reader to check the official Free plan before trying a weekly queue. Do not claim Buffer increases organic reach, saves a quantified amount of time, or supports every social channel.
